race.description: D & A Plumbing And Gas Mdn Hcp
race.comment: DIAMOND CHOUX (9) gets the nod on the strength of her Belmont fourth, where she was beaten just under four lengths after settling well back and making solid inroads from a wide run. She is race fit, comes out of mid-week company into an easier meeting, and her broader good-track profile keeps her clearly in the winning conversation. SANDY CHEEKS (12) has to rebound from a plain Northam eighth, but her previous run at this track was a head second to Choux'N'Whiskey and barrier 1 gives her every chance to reproduce that. DANCING SPIRIT (11) beat SANDY CHEEKS at Northam last time and had earlier run third at this venue, beaten a long neck, so her best recent form ties in strongly. MR UNIVERSE (3) brings consecutive Geraldton thirds and has placed three times from seven tries around 1500m. Can play a role. RISE TO OCCASION (10) is not to be discounted on debut.
